summary: Independent review of 165 rows (33 RAW x 5 TMT6plex channels, 2 deposited TMT mixes) found no blocker or important issues. The channel-to-condition mapping was reproduced independently (r = 1.000 against Table S1 Exp1/Exp2). Only minor improvements remain.

reviewer_context.context: fresh reviewer subagent dispatched by caller; producer transcript and report.md not read

spec_compliance.evidence: Active templates ms-proteomics 1.1.0 + vertebrates 1.1.0 (both latest in templates.yaml; extend sample-metadata/base). All required columns present (incl. developmental stage, disease, fraction identifier, label, technical replicate). 42 columns, 165 rows, no duplicate (data file, label) pairs, assay name == data file stem, factor values mirror characteristics.

ontology_integrity.evidence: OLS4 resolved PRIDE:0000627 Data-dependent acquisition, PRIDE:0000564 hpHRP, PRIDE:0000608 DTT, MS:1000133 CID, MS:1002732 Orbitrap Fusion Lumos, MS:1001309 Lys-C, CL:1000398 endothelial cell of hepatic sinusoid; none obsolete. sdrf-tools check: 15/15 verified, 0 label mismatches, 0 UNIMOD swaps (UNIMOD:4, 737, 35, 1).

source_evidence.evidence: PRIDE project and paper Methods 2.4/2.5 (PMC11494038) confirm C57Bl/6J male mice (Charles River, proteomics), CD146+ LSECs pooled from 4-5 livers, 1 h AIM-V alone and 10/48 h +/- 1 uM Dex, Lys-C then trypsin, 5 mM DTT, TMTsixplex, hpH RP 42->21 fractions, Fusion Lumos SPS-MS3, MaxQuant mods and 4.5/20 ppm. RAW metadata: Lumos, charge 2-7, CID MS2. Reviewer recomputed proteinGroups reporter (per-protein centred log2) vs Table_1.xlsx: TMT7 idx0-4 = NT_1h, NT_10h, Dex_10h, NT_48h, Dex_48h with Exp1 (r=1.000); TMT8 idx0-4 = NT_48h, Dex_48h, NT_1h, NT_10h, Dex_10h with Exp2 (r>=0.999); off-diagonal <=0.82. Empty channels (TMT7 127, TMT8 129) from producer RAW reporter counts; per-index MaxQuant totals reproduce the RAW non-empty intensity profile.

file_mapping.evidence: files.json (projectAccessions = PXD041381) lists 33 .raw + proteinGroups.txt; all 33 RAW appear exactly once as comment[data file] with 5 channel rows each; no non-raw or unmatched files. TMT9 (Exp3) RAW and TMT7 fractions 13-21 are not deposited, disclosed in manifest limitations.

design_consistency.evidence: 10 source names = 5 conditions x 2 biological replicates (rep1=TMT7/Exp1, 12 fractions; rep2=TMT8/Exp2, 21 fractions); each mix holds all 5 samples of one replicate as the paper states; one label per sample per mix; fractions 1-12 and 1-21; technical replicate 1; factors sampling time x treatment consistent with the non-factorial design (1 h untreated only).

omission_safety.evidence: No value asserts more than sources support: developmental stage and alkylation reagent left 'not available' rather than inferred; strain uses the paper's C57BL/6J for proteomics (not Janvier C57BL/6JRj used for other assays); disease normal for healthy donor mice. Remaining omissions (MS3 HCD, dose, age) are minor.

deterministic_validation.evidence: parse_sdrf validate-sdrf -t ms-proteomics -t vertebrates exit 0 (warnings only: free-text 'untreated' treatment, 'C57BL/6J' strain). sdrf-tools check CLEAN, sdrf-tools score 100/100, schema-check evidence manifest valid.

findings.message: Only CID is recorded; SPS-MS3 quantifies reporters from HCD MS3 scans.
findings.evidence: Paper and acquisition method TMT6_TKO_6plex_SPS describe SPS multi-notch MS3; ThermoRawFileParser 'Fragmentation types=CID' reflects MS2 only. Consider adding a second dissociation column NT=HCD;AC=MS:1000422 if the RAW MS3 filter confirms HCD.

findings.message: Alkylation reagent is 'not available' though the cited TMTsixplex kit protocol uses iodoacetamide.
findings.evidence: Methods follow the TMTsixplex kit protocol with only the reductant changed; PRIDE identifiedPTMs list MOD:00397 iodoacetamide derivatized residue. Conservative value acceptable; iodoacetamide is a defensible inference if stated as such.

findings.message: Dex dose (1 uM) and mouse age (6-12 weeks) are not captured in structured columns.
findings.evidence: Methods 2.4 'Dex treatment (1 uM = 0.4 ug/mL)'; Methods animals 'experiments at the age of 6-12 weeks'. Optional characteristics[compound]/[dose] and characteristics[age]=6W-12W could be added.

findings.message: MaxQuant reporter index-to-mass mapping assumes the 5 configured labels are in ascending mass order; empty-channel check covers one fraction per mix.
findings.evidence: proteinGroups has indices 0-4 only; RAW reporter counts (TMT7_A6 127 = 226/31167, TMT8_A5 129 = 329/32687) and matching per-index intensity profiles corroborate the assumption. MaxQuant mqpar.xml is not deposited.

findings.message: Fraction numbers are inferred from autosampler well order (TMT8 A1-A12, B4-B12 -> 1-21; TMT7 A1-A12 -> 1-12).
findings.evidence: No deposited fraction table; inference is disclosed in the evidence manifest and does not affect quantification grouping.
